title: The annual review: answering 'my SIP is running, what next?'
objectives: Show goal progress in rupees and percentage.
Suggest a step-up and a rebalance when due.
body_md:
This is the answer to "my SIP is running, what next?" A structured review at least once a year keeps clients on track and is where most long-term value is added.

## Annual review agenda (30–45 minutes)

- Life update: any change in income, family, job, goals or risk comfort?
- Goal progress: for each goal, how far along it is in rupees and percentage, and whether it's on track.
- Performance: portfolio and fund-level XIRR vs each fund's benchmark and category average over 3 and 5 years.
- Allocation check: current equity / debt / gold mix vs target; rebalance if it has drifted meaningfully.
- Overlap and clutter: too many funds holding the same stocks? Consolidate.
- Step-up: raise SIPs in line with income growth.
- Housekeeping: KYC status, nominations, bank mandates, contact details.
- Next actions: written summary sent to the client after the meeting.
example: A client's equity share has drifted to 72% against a 60% target. You suggest moving part of the gain into debt and stepping up the SIP by 10% with her raise, then send a written summary.
say: Your SIP is on track. This year, let's step it up by 10% and bring equity back to your 60% target.
Here is a written summary of what we agreed today.
never: Your SIP is running, so there's nothing to do.
We only need to meet when markets fall.

check.q: How often should a client receive a structured review, at minimum?
check.why: A yearly structured review is where most long-term value is added.

check.q: ₹10,000/month at an assumed 12% for 20 years, stepped up 10% every year, ends at about:
check.why: A flat SIP ends at ≈₹1 Cr. The 10% step-up nearly doubles it to ≈₹1.99 Cr (illustration only).

check.q: In an annual review, what is the purpose of the allocation check?
o: To compare the client with a friend
To see whether the equity, debt and gold mix has drifted from target
To choose a new fund house
To collect the next NFO order
check.why: The allocation check compares the current mix with the target and rebalances if it has drifted.
